known_limits: One probe per host. A host that is briefly down reads as UNREACHABLE, which is why UNREACHABLE is recorded and never treated as a state change.
Verdicts are point-in-time. Comparing two dates measures the pair of observations, not an operator's intent.
The target list is itself a snapshot of a live registry and shifts between runs.
manifest.method: preflight.classify(url) — one unauthenticated request per host, GET with a POST fallback. Nothing signed, nothing paid. A verdict describes what the endpoint served at that moment and nothing about the operator.
manifest.target_list_caveat: Offset pagination over a live registry is a snapshot, not an enumeration. Rows shift between requests; hosts present in one run can be absent from the next. Quote this timestamp alongside any figure derived from this run.
manifest.target_list_source: CDP Bazaar discovery listings, deduplicated to one probe URL per host
